title: Where the Visit Limit Runs Out and the Date a Waiver Covers From — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Decision table — Insured Plan of Care waivers.** The date the waiver covers from follows where the limit runs out, compared with the appointments still booked on the plan's active Appointment Series, as its record shows them remaining:

| Visits left under the limit | Compared with appointments still booked on the active series | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| Above zero | Equal | The first visit past the limit opens the plan's next booked Appointment Series, and the waiver covers from that opening visit |
| Above zero | More visits left than appointments still booked | No waiver is signed yet; it is signed on the day of the first visit that runs past the limit |
| Any other case | — | The waiver covers from today |

## Hypothetical cases

1. 3 visits left, 3 appointments still booked on the active series, next booked series opening 2026-08-03: the waiver covers from 2026-08-03.
2. 5 visits left, 3 still booked: no waiver is signed yet.
3. 2 visits left, 3 still booked: the waiver covers from today.
4. 0 visits left: the waiver covers from today.
